label: History
value: Billina survived a shipwreck
unit: Billina survived a shipwreck in a wooden coop alongside Dorothy Gale and reached the shore of the Land of Ev. While scratching for food in the sand, her beak struck a golden key that enabled Dorothy to unlock and wind up the mechanical man Tiktok. After being captured by Princess Langwidere, Billina was confined to a chicken house, where she fought and defeated the local rooster. She later joined Ozma's expedition to the Nome King's underground kingdom. While hiding beneath the Nome King's throne to sleep, she overheard him reveal that the enchanted royal family of Ev were turned into royal purple ornaments. She also laid an egg under the throne, alarming the Nomes, who considered eggs poisonous. Using her knowledge, Billina entered the enchanted palace and successfully identified and restored the Queen of Ev, her nine children, Ozma, and the soldiers of Oz. Her egg was then used by the Scarecrow to rout the Nome King's army, allowing Dorothy to take the King's magic belt. After the group returned to Ev, Billina discovered the transformed Tin Woodman in Prince Evring's pocket and restored him as well. She was presented with a jewel necklace in Ev, traveled to the Land of Oz, and chose to permanently reside there rather than return to America.

label: Personality
value: The Lion believes himself to be born a coward.
unit: Despite his large and fearsome appearance, the Lion believes himself to be born a coward and is deeply sorrowful and unhappy about his lack of courage. However, when his friends are threatened, he repeatedly overcomes his intense fear to defend and assist them. He enjoys natural forest surroundings over city life and behaves gently and politely toward small, helpless creatures.

label: History
value: The Lion attacked the Scarecrow
unit: While traveling through a forest, the Lion attacked the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, but was stopped when Dorothy slapped his nose for trying to bite Toto, forcing him to confess his innate cowardice. He joined Dorothy's party to ask the Great Oz for courage, carrying his companions across gulfs, swimming a river while pulling their raft, and facing down fierce Kalidahs and Winkies along the journey. After falling asleep in a poisonous poppy field, he was rescued by thousands of field mice on a wooden truck. Upon reaching Oz, he was ordered to slay the Wicked Witch of the West, during which he was captured by Winged Monkeys and imprisoned in a yard, resisting the Witch's attempts to starve and harness him. Following the Witch's destruction and Oz's exposure as a humbug, he drank a liquid given by Oz that made him feel brave, and later slew a giant spider terrorizing an ancient forest, earning the title of King of the Forest. Afterward, he rejoined Princess Ozma's court, befriended the Hungry Tiger, helped rescue Dorothy in Ev, and helped carry Ozma's party safely under the iron giant's hammer before returning triumphantly to the Emerald City.

label: History
value: Dorothy grew up in Kansas
unit: Dorothy grew up as an orphan in Kansas on a farm with her Uncle Henry and Aunt Em. A sudden cyclone carried her house into the Land of Oz, landing on and killing the Wicked Witch of the East. To find a way back home, she set out for the Emerald City alongside her dog Toto, meeting the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion along the way. Sent by Oz to eliminate the Wicked Witch of the West, Dorothy accidentally destroyed the Witch by throwing a bucket of water over her. After further travels, Glinda the Good revealed that her magic Silver Shoes could carry her home, and she clapped her heels together to return to Kansas. Later, Dorothy accompanied Uncle Henry on a sea voyage, but was swept overboard in a violent storm while clinging to a chicken-coop along with a yellow hen named Billina. They landed in the Land of Ev, where Dorothy discovered and wound up the mechanical man Tiktok and was captured by Princess Langwidere. Rescued by Princess Ozma and her old friends from Oz, Dorothy assisted in defeating the Nome King and rescuing the royal family of Ev. Following a joyful visit to the Emerald City, Dorothy used the Nome King's magic belt to join her ailing uncle in Australia, arranging for Ozma to check on her weekly through a magic picture.

label: History
value: Evardo was born as a prince of the Land of Ev.
unit: Evardo was born as a prince of the Land of Ev, the eldest son of King Evoldo and his Queen. His father sold him, along with his mother and nine siblings, to Roquat the Nome King in exchange for a long life. The Nome King transformed Evardo and his family into purple bric-a-brac and ornaments to decorate his palace rooms. He remained in this enchanted form until Billina the yellow hen correctly guessed the purple ornament representing him, restoring him to his human form along with his mother and siblings. After returning to the Land of Ev, he was presented to his subjects by the Queen mother. At fifteen years of age, he was crowned King Evardo Fifteenth, wearing a ruby-set golden crown and an ermine robe while receiving the allegiance of his people.

label: History
value: Evring was born a Prince of Ev.
unit: Evring was born a Prince of Ev, the youngest child of King Evoldo and the Queen of Ev. His father sold Evring, his mother, and his nine siblings to the Nome King, who transformed them into purple ornaments to decorate his palace. While in the palace, Evring remained enchanted as a purple kitten ornament until Dorothy touched him and spoke the magic word 'Ev', restoring him to his true form as a boy. Having lost his memories during his enchantment, he followed Dorothy back to the throne room, where he sat with her to await the rescue of the rest of his family. After Billina restored his mother and siblings, Evring re-entered the palace with his mother, who fondled and kissed her youngest child. While in the palace, Evring picked up a green tin whistle shaped like a pig and put it in his pocket, unwittingly carrying the transformed Tin Woodman along with him. He later rode back to the Land of Ev on the Sawhorse alongside Dorothy and Billina, accidentally scaring the Sawhorse by blowing a blast on his whistle. After Billina realized the whistle was the Tin Woodman and disenchanted him, they all safely arrived at the palace of Ev, where Evring's brother Evardo was crowned King.

label: History
value: Glinda welcomed Dorothy Gale.
unit: When Dorothy Gale journeyed to the South Country seeking a way home, Glinda welcomed her and revealed that her Silver Shoes possessed the magic power to carry her anywhere. In exchange for the Golden Cap, Glinda helped Dorothy return to Kansas and used her three commands to safely transport the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion to their respective kingdoms before freeing the Winged Monkeys. Later, when the Scarecrow and his companions came seeking aid against General Jinjur's Army of Revolt, Glinda examined her record books to discover the fate of Ozma, the true heir to the Emerald City. She marched her all-female army upon the Emerald City, captured the wicked witch Mombi, and forced her to undo the enchantment that had hidden Princess Ozma in the form of the boy Tip. After defeating Jinjur and restoring Ozma to the throne, Glinda continued to offer the young ruler wise counsel. Subsequently, Glinda presented Ozma with a Magic Carpet to enable her expedition to Ev to rescue its royal family, and later advised Dorothy on how to safely return to Uncle Henry in Australia using the Nome King's Magic Belt.

label: History
value: The Hungry Tiger left his home forest.
unit: After leaving his home forest to join his friend the Cowardly Lion, the Hungry Tiger accompanied Princess Ozma to the Land of Ev to assist in rescuing the royal family of Ev. Teamed with the Cowardly Lion, he was harnessed to Ozma's golden chariot and helped draw it across the desert. During their journey to the underground kingdom of the Nome King, he carried Dorothy on his back safely past the giant hammer and repeatedly leaped beneath it to rescue twenty-four officers of the army. At the Nome King's palace, he stood guard alongside the Lion to protect Dorothy and Prince Evring. Upon returning victorious to the Emerald City, he participated in a grand celebratory feast where he consumed everything on the table.

label: Personality
value: Jack is polite.
unit: Jack is polite, humble, and obedient, especially toward his creator, whom he considers his parent. He possesses a remarkably simple-minded and naive disposition, often confusing complex explanations or taking literal interpretations of figures of speech. Despite his carved smile, he suffers from frequent anxiety and fear that his pumpkin head will spoil or decay. Overall, he is genial, harmless, and good-natured toward everyone he meets.

label: History
value: Jack Pumpkinhead was created by Tip.
unit: Jack Pumpkinhead was created by a young boy named Tip out of wooden limbs and a carved pumpkin in order to frighten the witch Mombi. Mombi used her newly acquired Powder of Life to bring Jack to life, after which she locked him in a stable. Tip rescued Jack that night, and the two set off toward the Emerald City, during which Tip brought a Saw-Horse to life to carry Jack so his joints would not wear out. After getting separated from Tip, Jack arrived in the Emerald City and was granted an audience with King Scarecrow, with whom he quickly struck up a friendship. When General Jinjur's Army of Revolt conquered the city, Jack escaped alongside Tip, the Scarecrow, and the Saw-Horse on their way to seek help from the Tin Woodman. Throughout their travels—which included falling into a river, building a flying Gump machine, and getting trapped in a Jackdaw nest—Jack's left leg was replaced twice by his companions to mend broken limbs and repair the Saw-Horse. After Glinda restored Princess Ozma to the throne, Jack remained at the royal palace in the Emerald City to the end of his days. Although he proved too poor a student for the Woggle-Bug to educate, Jack remained active and read a congratulatory address to Ozma upon her return from rescuing a royal family.

label: History
value: Jinjur raised an Army of Revolt.
unit: Jinjur raised an Army of Revolt composed entirely of girls from across the Land of Oz to capture the Emerald City and seize its jewel-filled treasury. Taking advantage of the unarmed Royal Army, her forces successfully captured the city and dethroned the Scarecrow, placing Jinjur upon the throne as Queen. To maintain her hold on the city, she enlisted the aid of the witch Mombi. However, Glinda the Sorceress marched an army to the city, easily bypassed the gates using the Gump, and took Jinjur prisoner. Following the discovery of Princess Ozma as the rightful heir, Jinjur initially resisted before her army submitted. After being released upon promising good behavior, Jinjur returned to a quiet life, eventually marrying a man who owned nine cows and working as a dairy-maid.

label: Appearance
value: Princess Langwidere has thirty different heads.
unit: Princess Langwidere has thirty different heads—one for each day of the month—which she changes by unlocking her cabinet with a ruby key worn on a chain attached to her left wrist. Because she alters her head continuously, her appearance changes every time she is seen, though each head is more or less beautiful. One of her heads features black hair, dark eyes, and a pearl-and-white complexion; another has auburn hair and hazel eyes; and a third possesses chestnut hair, dreamy walnut eyes, and a hickorynut nose.

unit: Princess Langwidere has thirty different heads—one for each day of the month—which she changes by unlocking her cabinet with a ruby key worn on a chain attached to her left wrist. Because she alters her head continuously, her appearance changes every time she is seen, though each head is more or less beautiful. One of her heads features black hair, dark eyes, and a pearl-and-white complexion; another has auburn hair and hazel eyes; and a third possesses chestnut hair, dreamy walnut eyes, and a hickorynut nose.

label: Personality
value: Langwidere is extremely vain.
unit: Langwidere is extremely vain, indolent, and haughty, spending much of her time sitting in a room lined with mirrors to admire her own features while playing her mandolin. Her mood and temperament vary with the head she is wearing; for instance, head No. 17 possesses a fiery, harsh, and arrogant disposition that leads her to do unpleasant things. She is easily annoyed by others and dislikes heat, manual effort, and administrative duties, being eager to relinquish her position as ruler so she can spend her leisure time admiring her heads.

label: History
value: Princess Langwidere is the niece of King Evoldo
unit: As the niece of the late King Evoldo, Princess Langwidere lived in a wing of the royal palace of Ev and took money from the royal treasury following the imprisonment of the royal family. When Dorothy Gale, Tiktok, and Billina visited the palace to ask for help, Langwidere met them while wearing head No. 17. Finding Dorothy's head charming, she demanded that Dorothy swap heads with her, and locked the young girl in the North Tower when she refused. Soon after, Princess Ozma of Oz arrived with her army to liberate the royal family of Ev, causing Langwidere to immediately submit and release Dorothy. She declined to join Ozma's expedition to the Nome King due to her dislike of heat, returning instead to her cabinet to admire her heads. Following the rescue of the Queen of Ev and her children, Langwidere was relieved of her ruling duties and granted permission to retain her rooms and cabinet of heads for the rest of her life.

label: History
value: Mombi lived in the Gillikin Country.
unit: Mombi lived in the Gillikin Country, where she was suspected of practicing magical arts and raised the young boy Tip. She struck a deal with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz to hide the baby Princess Ozma, whom she transformed into Tip in exchange for learning the Wizard's magic. Later, Mombi acquired the Powder of Life from a crooked mountain wizard and brought Tip's pumpkin-headed man, Jack Pumpkinhead, to life. Threatening to transform Tip into a marble statue, she prompted the boy to steal her Powder of Life and flee with Jack. Mombi was subsequently summoned by General Jinjur to help the Army of Revolt defeat the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, using magical illusions to hinder their movements. When Glinda the Sorceress marched upon the Emerald City, Mombi repeatedly attempted to evade capture by transforming Jellia Jamb into her duplicate, turning herself into a red rose, a shadow, a black ant, and finally a griffin. Glinda ultimately captured her at the edge of the desert using a golden thread. Under the threat of death, Mombi confessed to Glinda that Tip was actually Princess Ozma. She then executed the magical incantation to restore Tip to her true form as Princess Ozma, forfeiting her own magical knowledge as a consequence.

unit: Mombi lived in the Gillikin Country, where she was suspected of practicing magical arts and raised the young boy Tip. She struck a deal with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz to hide the baby Princess Ozma, whom she transformed into Tip in exchange for learning the Wizard's magic. Later, Mombi acquired the Powder of Life from a crooked mountain wizard and brought Tip's pumpkin-headed man, Jack Pumpkinhead, to life. Threatening to transform Tip into a marble statue, she prompted the boy to steal her Powder of Life and flee with Jack. Mombi was subsequently summoned by General Jinjur to help the Army of Revolt defeat the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, using magical illusions to hinder their movements. When Glinda the Sorceress marched upon the Emerald City, Mombi repeatedly attempted to evade capture by transforming Jellia Jamb into her duplicate, turning herself into a red rose, a shadow, a black ant, and finally a griffin. Glinda ultimately captured her at the edge of the desert using a golden thread. Under the threat of death, Mombi confessed to Glinda that Tip was actually Princess Ozma. She then executed the magical incantation to restore Tip to her true form as Princess Ozma, forfeiting her own magical knowledge as a consequence.

unit: On the surface, the Nome King displays a merry, jolly, and good-humored demeanor, frequently laughing so hard that his belly shakes. label: History
value: King Roquat purchased the Queen of Ev from King Evoldo.
unit: King Roquat purchased the Queen of Ev and her ten children from King Evoldo, transforming them into palace ornaments. When Princess Ozma of Oz arrived with Dorothy Gale and an army to demand their release, the Nome King offered a game of guessing which ornaments held the captives, with the penalty of transformation for failure. He successfully trapped Ozma, the Tin Woodman, and twenty-seven Oz officers into becoming ornaments before the yellow hen, Billina, discovered the secret behind his enchantments. Billina successfully restored all the prisoners to life and laid an egg under his throne, horrifying the King due to Nomes' fatal fear of eggs. After the Scarecrow struck the King in the face with an egg, Dorothy stole his magic belt, stripping him of his powers. Defeated, helpless, and unable to prevent his prisoners from leaving, the Nome King sat scowling on his throne as his former captives departed.

label: History
value: Princess Ozma was taken from her father as an infant by the Wizard of Oz.
unit: As an infant, Princess Ozma was taken from her father by the Wizard of Oz and hidden with the witch Mombi, who transformed her into a boy named Tip. After growing up as Tip, her identity was revealed through Mombi's confession to Glinda the Sorceress, who compelled the witch to undo the transformation and restore Ozma to her true form. Glinda's army subsequently marched into the Emerald City, defeated Queen Jinjur's revolt, and crowned Ozma as the rightful ruler of Oz. As Queen, Ozma restored order, appointed key officials, and ruled with wisdom and justice with guidance from Glinda. Upon learning that the royal family of Ev had been enslaved by the Nome King, Ozma assembled her army and followers to march to their rescue using a magic carpet provided by Glinda. In the Nome King's underground palace, she courageously risked her own freedom in an attempt to guess which ornaments were the transformed royal family, resulting in her temporarily being changed into an emerald grasshopper. After being restored by Billina, Ozma led her group out of the mountain, successfully liberated the family of Ev, and returned in triumph to the Emerald City. She later hosted Dorothy Gale, showed her the magical shifting picture, and accepted the Nome King's magic belt to stay connected with Dorothy after sending her home.

value: The Saw-Horse's body is formed from a tree-trunk.

Its ears are carved out of tree bark and attached to bored holes in its head. A wooden post is driven into its back behind the head to serve as a handhold for riders. Later, Queen Ozma has its wooden feet shod with plates of gold to keep them from wearing out.

label: History
value: The Scarecrow was rescued from his pole in a Munchkin cornfield by Dorothy Gale.
unit: After being rescued from his pole in a Munchkin cornfield by Dorothy Gale, the Scarecrow joined her journey to the Emerald City to ask the Wizard for brains. Along the road, they recruited the Tin Woodman and the Cowardly Lion and survived numerous perils. Upon reaching the Emerald City, the Wizard required them to defeat the Wicked Witch of the West before granting his wish. During the battle against the Witch's minions, the Scarecrow single-handedly killed forty wild crows. After the Witch's defeat, the Wizard satisfied the Scarecrow's desire by filling his head with bran, needles, and pins. When the Wizard departed in his balloon, the Scarecrow was made the ruler of the Emerald City. He was later deposed by General Jinjur's Army of Revolt and escaped alongside Tip, Jack Pumpkinhead, and the Saw-Horse to seek aid from the Tin Woodman and Glinda. After losing his original straw filling to Jackdaws, his clothes were stuffed with banknotes, making him immensely valuable. Glinda subsequently established that Princess Ozma was the rightful ruler of Oz, whereupon the Tin Woodman appointed the Scarecrow as Royal Treasurer. Later, he joined Ozma's expedition to the Nome Kingdom to rescue the royal family of Ev, where he was temporarily transformed into a gold ornament by the Nome King before being restored.

label: History
value: Tiktok was discovered by Dorothy Gale in a rocky cavern in the Land of Ev.
unit: Tiktok was discovered by Dorothy Gale in a rocky cavern in the Land of Ev, where he was wound up and immediately pledged his faithful service to her. He protected Dorothy and Billina from the Wheelers by using a tin dinner pail to fight them off and capturing their chief. After leading the party to the royal palace of Ev, he knocked down several soldiers attempting to arrest Dorothy before his action clockwork ran down. When Ozma of Oz arrived to free Dorothy, Tiktok was rewound and joined the expedition to rescue the royal family of Ev from the Nome King. Along the journey, he successfully bypassed the Nome King's giant iron hammer. During the guessing game in the Nome King's palace, Tiktok ran out of guesses and was transformed into a golden ornament. He was eventually restored to his proper form by Billina and Ozma, and after the party safely escaped back to Oz, he received emerald-set bracelets at a celebratory feast. Dorothy decided not to bring him to Australia, leaving him in the care of Princess Ozma in the Land of Oz.

His polished body shines brightly, although it is occasionally marked with solder patches from repairs or coated in polishing paste.

His polished body shines brightly, although it is occasionally marked with solder patches from repairs or coated in polishing paste.

value: The Tin Woodman is exceptionally polite.

He is deeply devoted to his friends, sensitive to the distress of others, and readily moved to tears of sympathy.

label: History
value: The Tin Woodman was rusted immobile in the forest.
unit: After being rusted immobile in the forest, the Tin Woodman was rescued when Dorothy Gale and the Scarecrow oiled his joints. He joined their journey to the Emerald City to ask the Wizard Oz for a heart. Along the way, he used his axe to clear pathways, defend the group against wolves, build rafts and trucks, and rescue the Queen of the Field Mice. After defeating the Wicked Witch of the West, he was repaired by the Winkies, received a stuffed silk heart from Oz, and was invited by the Winkies to become their Emperor. Later, when the Scarecrow was deposed from the Emerald City, the Tin Woodman joined his friends to help reclaim the throne, constructing the Flying Gump machine to escape captivity. Subsequently, he commanded Ozma's army on an expedition to the Land of Ev and the Nome Kingdom, where he was temporarily transformed into an ornamental whistle by the Nome King before being restored and welcomed home.

label: History
value: Tip grew up in the Country of the Gillikins.
unit: Tip grew up in the Country of the Gillikins working on the farm of the sorceress Mombi. To play a joke on her, he carved a wooden figure with a pumpkin head named Jack Pumpkinhead. After Mombi brought Jack to life using the Powder of Life and threatened to turn Tip into a marble statue, Tip fled during the night, bringing Jack and the Powder of Life with him. Along his journey to the Emerald City, he used the magic powder to bring a Saw-Horse to life. Upon arriving near the city, he encountered General Jinjur's Army of Revolt and fled with the Scarecrow, Jack, and the Saw-Horse. After escaping to the Winkie Country and joining forces with the Tin Woodman and the Highly Magnified Woggle-Bug, Tip constructed a flying creature called the Gump, animating it with the last of the Powder of Life. After various adventures, the group sought aid from Glinda the Good. Glinda captured Mombi and forced her to reveal that Tip was actually Princess Ozma, the rightful ruler of Oz whom the Wizard had brought to Mombi as an infant to be transformed into a boy. Tip reluctantly agreed to be restored to his original form, becoming Princess Ozma.

label: Appearance
value: Toto is a tiny black dog.
unit: Toto is a tiny black dog with long silky hair and small black eyes that twinkle merrily on either side of his funny, wee nose. He is a 'meat dog' rather than a stuffed creature or one made of metal, and is remarkably small in size. During his travels in Oz, he wears a green ribbon around his neck that later changes to pure white, and he is eventually given a golden collar by the Winkies.

label: History
value: Toto lived with Dorothy, Uncle Henry, and Aunt Em in a small house on the Kansas prairies.
unit: Toto lived with Dorothy, Uncle Henry, and Aunt Em in a small house on the Kansas prairies, where his playfulness brought joy to Dorothy. When a cyclone lifted their house into the air, Toto accidentally fell into the open cyclone cellar hatch but was rescued by Dorothy before they both fell asleep. Upon landing in the Land of Oz, Toto accompanied Dorothy on her journey down the yellow brick road to the Emerald City. Along the way, he met the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and defended Dorothy against the Cowardly Lion before becoming good friends with them. During their adventures, Toto survived the deadly poppy field by being carried out alongside Dorothy, was taken to the Wicked Witch of the West's castle, and even bit the Wicked Witch when she struck him with her umbrella. After returning to the Emerald City, his barking at a kitten accidentally knocked over a screen, revealing the Wizard of Oz to be an ordinary little man. Following further travels south to see Glinda the Good, Toto returned safely to Kansas with Dorothy when she used her Silver Shoes, where he was later seen sleeping in the sun on the side porch of the new farmhouse.

When a cyclone lifted their house into the air, Toto accidentally fell into the open cyclone cellar hatch but was rescued by Dorothy before they both fell asleep. Upon landing in the Land of Oz, Toto accompanied Dorothy on her journey down the yellow brick road to the Emerald City. Along the way, he met the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and defended Dorothy against the Cowardly Lion before becoming good friends with them. During their adventures, Toto survived the deadly poppy field by being carried out alongside Dorothy, was taken to the Wicked Witch of the West's castle, and even bit the Wicked Witch when she struck him with her umbrella. After returning to the Emerald City, his barking at a kitten accidentally knocked over a screen, revealing the Wizard of Oz to be an ordinary little man. Following further travels south to see Glinda the Good, Toto returned safely to Kansas with Dorothy when she used her Silver Shoes, where he was later seen sleeping in the sun on the side porch of the new farmhouse.

label: History
value: Uncle Henry lived on the great Kansas prairies.
unit: Uncle Henry lived on the great Kansas prairies in a small one-room house with his wife, Aunt Em, and their orphan niece, Dorothy. When a cyclone struck their farm, he ran to look after the stock while Dorothy was swept away inside the house. Following the disaster, he rebuilt the farmhouse on the broad prairie. After working so hard on his farm that his health gave way, leaving him weak and nervous, he left Aunt Em to manage the farm and set sail for Australia with Dorothy to visit unseen relatives and get rest. During a fierce storm at sea, Dorothy was blown overboard and disappeared, leaving Uncle Henry sad, lonely, thin, and wasted in Sydney as he worried over her loss. When Dorothy magically transported herself to his side in Australia using the magic belt, he embraced her, cheered by her safe return.

label: History
value: The Wicked Witch of the West conquered the West country of the Land of Oz.
unit: The Wicked Witch of the West conquered the West country of the Land of Oz and made the Winkies her slaves by using the magical Golden Cap to command the Winged Monkeys. She also used the cap's charm a second time to defeat the Great Oz and drive him out of the West. When Dorothy and her companions traveled into her territory under orders from Oz to destroy her, the Witch spotted them from her castle with her powerful single eye. She sent her pack of wolves, flock of wild crows, swarm of black bees, and a group of Winkie slaves to kill or scare them, but all were defeated in turn. Forced to use the Golden Cap's third and final charm, she commanded the Winged Monkeys to destroy the Tin Woodman and Scarecrow, capture the Lion, and carry Dorothy safely to her castle. Because Dorothy bore the kiss of the Good Witch of the North and wore the Silver Shoes, the Witch dared not harm her directly and instead forced her to work as a kitchen slave while attempting to starve the Lion into submission. Desiring the immense power of the Silver Shoes, the Witch tricked Dorothy by making an invisible iron bar on the kitchen floor to trip her, causing one shoe to fall off so she could snatch it. In anger, Dorothy threw a bucket of water over the Witch, unaware that water would dissolve her. The Witch wailed in despair as she melted into a shapeless brown mass on the floor, leaving only the single silver shoe behind.

label: History
value: Originally, the ventriloquist was from Omaha.
unit: Originally a circus ventriloquist from Omaha, he drifted to the Land of Oz in a hot-air balloon as a young man. The locals believed him to be a powerful magician, so he accepted their homage, usurped the ruler Pastoria, and hid the infant Princess Ozma with the witch Mombi. He commissioned the construction of the Emerald City and required all inhabitants to wear locked green-tinted spectacles so that the city appeared made of emeralds. To maintain his authority without revealing his ordinary nature, he lived shut away in his palace, using elaborate props and ventriloquism to simulate magical appearances. When Dorothy and her companions arrived asking for favors, he promised to grant them if they killed the Wicked Witch of the West. Upon their return, Toto accidentally knocked down the screen in the Throne Room, exposing him as a humbug. To keep his promises, he stuffed the Scarecrow's head with bran and pins, gave the Tin Woodman a silk heart, and made the Lion drink a potion for courage. He then constructed a green silk hot-air balloon to escape back to Omaha with Dorothy, but the ropes snapped prematurely, carrying him away alone into the sky.

label: Appearance
value: The Woggle-Bug is a greatly magnified insect.
unit: The Woggle-Bug is a greatly magnified insect, standing upright at a height comparable to the Tin Woodman. He has a flat, round body that is a glistening dark brown on the back and striped with light brown and white across the front, supported by slender legs with curling toes and thin arms. His neck supports a humanlike head with bulging black eyes, a nose ending in a curling antenna, and ears decorated with antennae resembling miniature pigtails. He wears a dark-blue swallowtail coat with a yellow silk lining, a tight white duck vest, fawn-colored plush knickerbockers with gilt buckles, and a tall silk hat.

label: History
value: The Woggle-Bug escaped from Professor Nowitall's schoolhouse while highly magnified.
unit: After escaping from Professor Nowitall's schoolhouse while highly magnified, the Woggle-Bug encountered Tip, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Jack Pumpkinhead, and the Saw-Horse, and joined their journey to the Emerald City. Along the way, he irritated his companions with puns and assertions of his superior education, but shared in their perils, including Mombi's magic fire illusion and Queen Jinjur's siege. When the party fled the palace aboard the Gump, he helped transport the creature's head and was later stranded in a Jackdaws' nest, where he was hidden under straw to protect him from the birds. During these travels, he swallowed a silver Wishing Pill to repair the Gump's broken wings and acquired two gold bracelets. Upon reaching Glinda's castle, he accompanied her army to overthrow Jinjur and restore Princess Ozma to the throne. Following Ozma's ascension, he was appointed Public Educator of the Emerald City and later became the president of the College of Art and Athletic Perfection.

unit: Zeb is a little boy who travels with Dorothy and Jim the Cab Horse. He is swallowed up in an earthquake and reaches a strange vegetable land. From there, they escape to the Land of Oz, where they reunite with Dorothy's old friends.
